sample.sampling: fixed-seed class-balanced sample from the common chronological test set
sample.event_level_summary: median of repeated measurements per event
sample.p95_confidence_interval: percentile bootstrap over event medians (2000 replicates)

measurement_boundaries.model_ready_inference: Preprocessing and structural assembly completed before timing; measures only the frozen estimator or neural forward pass on a single event representation.
measurement_boundaries.in_memory_raw_to_score: Begins with the required raw rows already resident in memory and includes feature preprocessing, sequence or local-subgraph assembly, tensor conversion, and the frozen model forward pass. Excludes disk I/O, model deserialization, and network I/O.

interpretation_boundary: These measurements compare steady-state CPU scoring under matched software and thread conditions. They are not deployment service-level measurements.
